decision.title: XSD and schema-aware conformance sweep 1 (packet )
decision.summary: The QT4 driver stops reclassifying schema-aware outcomes, fixing the two cases at their causes; validation descriptions use message templates, and one XPath record compiler serves assertions, alternatives and identity constraints.

body.p: . Amends (its QT4 outcome rules); resolves three Proposed items (validation descriptions, locations of configured schema documents, a simple base for a complex type).

item.p: Honest outcomes (amends ). The QT4 driver no longer counts a schema-aware test case that ends at the step or memory limit as "fail", nor one that stops at SXML_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE as "not run": 's zero errors must not be met by reclassification. Identity constraints () and assertions () run. The two cases moved are fixed at their causes:

app-CatalogCheck Catalog009 (536 MB): a group by packed every variable of the FLWOR into its tuples and concatenated each per group (XQuery 4.0, 4.13.8), here $testsets, 737 documents, once per dependency (18,564 tuples). A variable that no variable reference or grouping specification from the group by clause on names (the later clauses and the return clause; any reference of the name counts) is left out of the tuples: its grouped value is never read (src/xquery_lower.c). 147 MB; passes.

app-Demos itunes (10^8 steps): the query compares the keys of 6,597 tracks of a 10 MB library once per artist, 367 million steps by 's accounting. A FILTER whose predicate is a leaf (BINARY, UNARY, CAST, CASTABLE, INSTANCE_OF over atoms) that reads the focus computes it in the filter's own task, one step per item instead of two (src/evaluator.c), and the typed value of an xs:string node is its string value without a cast (src/xdm_node.c): 287 million steps. The QT4 driver's budget per evaluation is four times SXML_QT4_TEST_MAXIMUM_STEP_COUNT, as the XSLT driver's (, for a whole large input); itunes passes in 85 s (release).

Validation descriptions name what failed. A description is a message template (glossary message_template, src/schema_validate_value.c): static text with placeholders for the element or attribute as written, a value (quoted, shortened past 60 bytes, one line), a type ("type 'xs:decimal'", or "an anonymous type derived from ..."), the expected terms of the content model cursor (list_expected), and the facet the cast names with its value from the type or its nearest registered base. Every cvc-* report uses one: "element 'price' is not allowed here; expected 'title'", "element 'p:price' lacks the required attribute 'currency'", "element 'price' has the value '-1.005', which is not valid for type 'price': the value is below the minInclusive facet (...); the minInclusive facet is '0'", identity constraints with their element and constraint, assertions with their test. A template per site keeps the WebAssembly module in its budget (pieces built at run time did not: sxml.wasm 1,997,902 of 2,000,000 bytes). The description is made per report, so the first one goes to the error record through the item heap (sxml_item_heap_raise_error, ).

Configured schema documents are located by the library: one that is not well-formed is reported at the parser's line and column, one that is not a schema document at its document element, both with its URI as source name (sxml_schema_report_request.document_uri); sxml validate maps URIs to names only (standard input stays "-").

One XPath record compiler: sxml_schema_compile_xpath_record (src/schema_assertion.c, XPath Valid, 3.13.6.2) for assertions, type alternatives, selectors and fields ('s open item); selectors and fields now get the record's base URI too.

XSD: src-redefine 6.2.2 and 7.2.2: a group or attribute group redefined without a self-reference gets two unnamed complex types, one of the original's content or attributes and a restriction of it of the redefinition's, so COMPLEX_TYPES checks the restriction with its own rules (cos-content-act-restrict; derivation-ok-restriction 2 to 4, as 7.2.2 says) at the redefinition; a default open content with appliesToEmpty false is dropped when the explicit content type is empty (3.4.2.3.3 clause 6.1, open_content_skips_empty); the children of xs:override are read with the overridden document's defaults (4.2.5: they stand in '); a complex type with simple content is registered with its simple base (types.c accepts it, 3.4.1); "-0000" is year zero (Part 2, D.3.1; also QT4 cbcl-cast-gYearMonth-004a).

Not done: is-id of union and list elements (the start event is sent before the value is known; it needs the start held back to the end of simple content); src-include for an include that cannot be read (XSD 1.1, 4.2.3 makes it no error; 's deviation stays); the assertion leftovers of (no test of the suite needs them); the pattern facet on canonical forms was already done (sxml_cast_check_item_facets). Remaining XSD failures: XSD 1.0 rules XSD 1.1 dropped or changed (prohibited uses with fixed values, annotations), xs:NOTATION as a union member (), XML 1.1 instances, Element Declarations Consistent with wildcards and type tables (saxon wild078, 079, 081).

Also: src-ct for mixed attributes of xs:complexType and xs:complexContent that disagree and for xs:openContent in a restriction without a particle (the schema for schema documents, XSD 1.1 bug 16786); Wildcard Subset with its disallowed-names clauses (3.10.6.2 clauses 2 to 4) in one function, sxml_schema_wildcard_is_subset, for content and attribute wildcards (two copies merged).

Measured (release, every suite run with this code): XSD in scope 41,483 of 41,518 (was 41,452; gate groups 100 %, 99.7 %, 99.6 %; no test set lost a test; slice 147); XP40 30,931 (was 30,924), XQ40 41,273 (was 41,261), both 0 errors, schema-aware XQ40 1,236 of 1,516; XT40 7,992 (was 7,990); QT4 slice 198.

sources.source: XSD, XP40, XQ40 (and schema-aware) and XT40 passes, every suite run with this code, and the slices
app-CatalogCheck Catalog009 memory (536 MB to 147 MB) and app-Demos itunes steps (367 to 287 million) and time (85 s)
sxml.wasm stripped with run-time built descriptions (1,997,902 of 2,000,000 bytes)
configured: the QT4 driver's step budget per evaluation, four times SXML_QT4_TEST_MAXIMUM_STEP_COUNT
